verdict.rationale: Discord's REST/Gateway API, webhooks, OAuth2, and slash-command/interaction docs show a substantial surface for bot/app automation (discord-docs-35,4,10,7), but the evidence never claims or demonstrates that the API exposes full user-account/UI parity — things like Nitro customization, voice/video streaming, custom themes, or general end-user actions have no documented API equivalents, and no OpenAPI spec was found (discord-probe-3), suggesting no canonical single source proving full coverage. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for non-bot end-user UI features (profile customization, voice/video, themes), and any explicit API-vs-UI parity statement or audit.
